headline: Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Looks Pricey On Cash Flow And Earnings After 6x Run
summary: Quanta Services stock has delivered a very large 5 year gain while current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model both indicate the shares trade at a premium to that estimate. Quanta Services has returned about 6.4x over the past 5 years, which sets a high bar for any further upside to be justified by fundamentals.
